header: 2D MeshNet, gridding-free dilation schedule (RF = 255 px), adapted for full-disk H-alpha at 1024 px
comment: Same coprime ramp 1,3,5,7,13,19,31,19,13,7,5,3,1 (13 conv layers + final 1x1). RF = 1 + 2*127 = 255 px, which at 1024 px covers the 95th-percentile filament spine length (~193 px). Width is set by --channels in train.py (the 3D original's 5-6 channels were a memory limit that 2D does not have). GroupNorm (one group per channel, affine) + GELU in every block, no skips.
